⚖️ Looking for a Junior Advocate | Patna High Court
Not just a position — an opportunity to learn litigation from the ground up.
I am looking for a sincere and hardworking Junior Advocate who is genuinely interested in building a career in High Court litigation.
What you will get practical exposure to:
 • Legal research & case-law reading
 • Drafting petitions, applications & legal notices
 • Filing & e-filing
 • Mentioning & court proceedings
 • Case preparation, briefing & conference
 • Civil, Criminal, Family & Writ matters
What I am looking for:
 ✓ Willingness to learn
 ✓ Good drafting & research ability
 ✓ Regularity in Court work
 ✓ Professional discipline
 ✓ Sincerity, commitment & patience
For a young advocate, the first few years of practice are about learning, observing, drafting, appearing and understanding how litigation actually works.
If you are serious about learning practical High Court work and developing a strong foundation in litigation, you may connect with me on LinkedIn.
📍 Patna High Court, Patna, Bihar
Adv. Smriti Tiwari
 Advocate, Patna High Court
